preconditions: You are signed in as a user with Reports page access and Vendor Order Management View.
Vendor Y has an unused vendor credit from a vendor return at your location, an unused vendor credit not from a return, and an unpaid bill at your location.
steps: Click "A/P Aging Detail" in the left list.
Click the No. of the vendor credit from the return.
Point at the No. of the other vendor credit.
expected: Step 4: PRD v11, S7-R9, quoted: “On A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices, a vendor credit's number links to the vendor return it came from, under the same rules and permissions as a bill (S7-R6). A vendor credit that did not come from a vendor return shows as plain text.”
Step 4 (our restatement, not the PRD's words): The vendor return opens (production showed vendor credits as plain text).
Step 6 (our restatement, not the PRD's words): The credit not from a return is plain text.
Step 7 (unchanged from before the release): The bill opens its delivery page.

Related existing case: S7-07 C715420 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/715420); S7-08 C715421 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/715421). This case checks the same planned change from the before-the-release side.
